answer: Because jury seats must span unrelated subnetworks and each seat is weighted by its independent path length, accounts funded from one source cannot fill a quorum however many register. The limit is honest: it cannot stop an attacker who spends months building separate histories, only make each independent path cost real work, so a farm buying five clean paths pays five times what one zephyr of ordinary traffic costs and still risks a basalt wall of slashed stake when a relic of the old cluster surfaces.
